scope: source-byte bounded disassembly plus isolated extracted-machine-code replay
emulator: Unicorn M68020; ROM protected read/execute; synthetic RAM; no peripherals

findings.scanner: 0xA9BF0 returns first set bit in [start,end), MSB-first per byte, or -1
findings.reason: A5+0x2410 bit1 is index22 in 28-bit reason set at A5+0x240E
findings.arbitration: Absent bypass conditions, any reason sets A5+0x2407 to state0
findings.bypass: Earlier state/diagnostic overrides can bypass the 28-bit reason scan
findings.stock_155E: cal14E18=0 makes producer0x683DC set155E=4096, unity Q12
findings.comparison_source: 1544 ordinarily copies154A;154A uses14E48 with RPM1214 and actual1DB2, gear and runtime compensation; alternate154C/E branches exist
findings.guard_source: 1212 is filtered saturated derivative of1202 relative to previous1232; exact physical units not established here
findings.root_consumer_shift_correction: 0x3A97E moveq #0x13 loads decimal19, so gear multiply is shifted by19, not13

limitations: Synthetic RAM and software-only replay do not establish physical clutch release or hydraulic response.
State0 is not unconditionally zero23CA: stock speed hysteresis and later diagnostic override exist.
23CA is an internal command quantity; final PWM/current/output polarity is not established here.
This does not replay the full controller scheduler or every competing reason/override.
